book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Luka

content: Lilakalilu panani ja undumila kubheli
Chikahi bhandu bhamaheli pabhakabhi bhalibhongini mbaka kukanyatana, Yesu akatumbwi hoti kupwagha na bhabhulwa bhaki, “Mlilingalya na amila ja undumila kubheli ja Mafalisayo.
Njeta lilobhi lelihiyakiki ambalu ngaliyekuliwi, wala lelihiyakiki ambalu ngalimanyikane.
Henu, kila chendongila kulubhendu bhandu anabhaghajowana paunang'anu, na kila chenjojalanya koni njighi milyangu kuchumba, ghitangazwa panani ja unhaghala wa nyumba.”
Joapalika kujoghupeka
“Numpwaghi, mwanganya mwabhakochi bhangu, ngamwajoghopa bhala bhabhakoma hyegha nambu anabhajomwile ngachebhaweza kuhenga kabheti chindu chokapi kupetalela.
Ananundangia jola joapalika kujoghupeka. Munjoghupa jola, ambaju anaakomiki, abhi na uwezu wa kundekela ku motu wa jehanamu. Chakaka numpwaghila, jonihoju nde jumu joapalika kujoghupeka!”
“Bho, iwebha nhwanu ngacheilombaseka kwa sendi ibhele? Nambu njeta chiwebha hata chimu chechijewakeka palongi jaka Chapanga.
Kabheti hata majunju gha mimutu jinu ghabhalangiki ghokapi. Ngamwijoghopa, maghambu mabhanganya mpalika nakanopi kupeta iwebha yamahele!
Kunjetakela na kunkana Kristo
“Chakaka numpwaghila, mundu jokapi joanyetakela nepani palongi ja bhandu, Mwana waka Mundu najombi anaanjetakalya palongi ja bhatumika bha kunani bhaka Chapanga.
Nambu mundu jokapi joangana palongi ja bhandu, Mwana waka Mundu najombi anaankana palongi ja bhatumika bha kunani bhaka Chapanga.
“Mundu jokapi joandongale lilobhi lihakau Mwana waka Mundu analekakiwaje, nambu mundu jokapi joantondo Roho Mhuhu ngailekakewi ng'o.
“Pabhampelaka mwanganya palongi ja nyumba ya kuhimangani Bhayahude, na palongi ja ihongozi, na bhatawala, ngamwijoghopa ntundu momwalikengalyaje panani ja malobhi ghamwilongilaje.
Ndandi chikahi chenihechi Roho Mhuhu anaambola chela chempalika kulongela.”
Ulenganesu waka mwanahindu yamaheli ng'ang'a
Mundu jumu pa lipogha la bhandu lela akumpwaghi Yesu, “Mbola, umpwaghila ndongu wangu tughabhana upwelelu ghoatuleki atati witu.”
Yesu akamuyangiki, “Nkoche, bho, nde nane joamekiki nepani kubha mtemula au kubha mundu wa kubhaghabhanaki bhandu hindu yabho?”
Yesu akajendali kubhapwaghi bhokapi, “Mulijepa na ntundu wokapi wa kubha na wime! Ndandi hindu ngacheiweza kukengalela womi waka mundu, hata ngati anabhi na hindu yamahele.”
Bhela Yesu akabhapwaghi ulenganesu ghongo, “Kukabhi na mundu jumu mwanahindu yamaheli joakabhi na ngonda ghoubholalanile ghoupiika mahunu ghamaheli.
Jombi akatumbwi kuholalela mumtima waki, ‘Ngachemi na pandu pa kubheka mahunu ghangu ghokapi. Bho, ndenda bhole?’
Akalipwaghi, ‘Anandenda ana, anamombula ugholu wangu na kuchenga ugholu ukolongwa nakanopi. Nanatu anameka monihomu mahunu ghangu ghokapi na hindu yangu yengi.’
Bhela ananilipwaghila namwete, ‘Wenga mtima wangu! Sajenu ubhi na hindu yamaheli yambone ya kujaghanila kwa hyaka yamaheli. Upomulyaje, ukulaji, ukunywaji na kuhekalela!’
Nambu Chapanga akampwaghile, ‘Ung'ang'a wenga! Lalenu ikilu roho jaku anajitolakikaje, henu bho, hindu yokapi yeulilundakile anaikubha yaka nane?’ ”
Yesu akajomuli kwa kupwagha, “Ana nde mokubhelile kwaka mundu joalilundaki hindu kwa ndandi jaka mwene, nambu palongi jaka Chapanga ngacheabhalangika kubha na chindu.”
Munhobhalya Chapanga

Bhela Yesu akabhapwaghi bhabhulwa bhaki, “Kwa ndandi jeniheji numpwaghila, ngamwikubha na choghohi kubhokana na chilebhi chemchipala nahuli mpata kubha bhomi, wala ingobhu yemuipala kwa ndandi ja hyegha yinu.
Ndandi womi nde wambone nakanopi kupeta chilebhi, na hyegha nde jambone nakanopi kupeta ingobhu.
Mughalingalya makongolu, ngacheghapanda, wala ngacheghahuna, wala ngacheghabhi na ugholu, nambu Chapanga aghaleha! Mwabhanganya mpalika nakanopi kupeta ijuni!
Bho, nde nane pachilanda jinu, kwa kuhangajika kwaki, aweza kulijonjuke hata lisaa limu nakanopi ja chikahi cha womi wake?
Ngati ngachemuweza kutenda lijambu lichokopi ngati leniheli, bho, maghambu kiki mng'ahikila mambu ghange?

Ndingalya malobha moghakolela, ngacheghahenga lihengu wala ngacheghaloka. Nambu numpwaghila, hata Nkolongwa Solomoni na hindu yaki yokapi ngacheakawatikwi ingobhu jejiweza kulengana na unyahi wa lilobha limu.

Bhela ngati Chapanga aghawatika mahamba gha mungonda ngati bhenibhela ghaghabhonikana pambani lalenu na chilabhu kutaghakika pamotu. Bho, ngaiwezi kunhwatika mwanganya nakanope? Mwenga mabhandu mwembi na uhobhalelu uchoko!
“Bhela ngamwing'ahika mumitima jinu kubha anankula kiki au anankunywa kiki.
Ndandi ghanihagha ghokapi bhaghahangajaki bhandu bhokapi bhangakummanya Chapanga. Nambu Atati winu wa kunani kumahunde amanya kubha muipala hindu yeniheyi.
Nambu mwanganya ndonda hoti Ukolongwa waka Chapanga, najombi anaampekya hindu yeniheyi yokapi.
Kulibheke hindu yamaheli kunani kumahunde
“Ngamwijoghopa, mwenga lipogha lichoku, maghambu Atati winu apaliki kumpeke mwehapa Ukolongwa waki.

Ndombisa hindu yinu na mukabhaghabhila bhahochu mbija yene. Mulibhekila nkoba wanga kulala na mulibhekila chikoku kunani kumahunde, changakuweza kujomoka. Maghambu konihoku bhihi ngachebhaweza kujibha, wala mangeki ngacheghayonanga.
Maghambu pandu pachibhi chikoku chaku, nde pala pawibya mtima waku.”
Bhatumika bhamboni
“Mulikonga ulamba mwibhunu hinu, na taa yinu ikayakaje.
Mbya ngati bhatumika bhabhundendalela bambo wabhu ahika kuhuma ku ndowa. Nahuli anahikiki na kuhodima bhunhoghulya ndyango.

Mbanga bhatumika bhala, ambabhu bambo wabhu paikelabhukaje anaabhaketanyaje bhabhi mihu! Numpwaghi chakaka, bambo hoju anaalikongaje ulamba muchibhuno, na kubhapwaghila bhatama pahi pachilebhi, na kubhatumakila.
Mbanga bhatumika bhala, ambabhu bombo wabhu anaabhahimanyaje bhabhi mihu hata ngati anahiki ikilu pa mahiku au pachibhombu!
Nambu mmanya kubha, ngati mweni nyumba akamanyiki lisaa la kuhika mwihi, akabya atemi mihu, ngaakajilekiki nyumba jaki jibhombuliwaje na mwihi.
Nanamu mkubhaje tayali, maghambu Mwana waka Mundu anahika lisaa langakumanyikana.”
Mtumika ndongwana na jwangakubha ndongwana
Petulu akundaluki Yesu, “Bambo, bho, ulenganesu aghoghu utulongale tepani au bhandu bhokape?”

Bambo akamuyangiki, “Bho, henu nde nane joabhi mtumika ndongwana na joabhi na malango? Nde jola ambaju bambo waki ambei kubhajemalela bhatumika bhaki bhangi na kubhapeke chilebhi chabhu kwa chikahi chechipalika.
Apengaliki mtumika jola, ambaju anangati bambo waki akelabhuka anhimani akahenga bhenibhela.
Chakaka numpwaghila, bambo waki anaambeka mtumika jola kubha njemalela wa hindu yaki yokapi.

Nambu anangati mtumika jola alipwaghi mweni muntima waki, ‘Bambo wangu anaakabhakya kukelabhuka,’ na bhela kutumbu kubhalapu bhatumika bhajaki, akambomba na akanalomi, najombi akula na kunywa na kulobhela.
Bhela bambo waka mtumika jola anahika lichobha langa kumanyikana na lisaa langa kumanyikana. Na bambo hoju anaanhekata ipandi ibheli na kumbeka papamu na bhandu bhangakuhobhalela.
“Mtumika joamanya mambu ghaapala bambo waki ahengaji, nambu alepale kulibheka wichu na kukotoka kuhenga mambu ghaapala bambo jola, mtumika hoju ayilapulika nakanopi.

Nambu mtumika jola jwangakumanya mambu ghaapala bambo waki ahengaje, najombi ahenga mambu ghaghapalika kutemulika, mtumika hoju ayipulika pachokopi. Kwa ndandi mundu jokapi joajopali yamaheli ayijopakika yamahele. Na mundu jokapi joajopali yamahele nakanopi, ayijopakika yamahele nakanopi kuhuma kwaki.
Yesu nde ndandi ja kulekangana kwa bhandu
“Nhikiki kupambaki motu pani pundema, nenga mbala nakanopi kubhona ukabya ujomwi kubhelela!
Nambu mi na ubatizu ghombalika kubatizwa, nanatu anang'ahakika namaa mbaka ubatizu hoghu ujomukaje.
Bho, muhambuki nhikiki kuleta lukwale kwa bhandu pani pundema? Ngabhela! Ngachenhikiki kubhatenda bhandu bhatama kwa lukwale, nambu nhikiki kubhalekanisha bhandu.
Maghambu kutumbu sajenu bhandu nhwanu bha nyumba jimu anabhakomanaje, bhatatu kwa bhabheli na bhabheli kwa bhatatu.

Atati anakomana na mwana waki, na mwana anakomana na atati waki. Amabhu anakomana na mwali waki, na mwali anakomana na mabhu waki. Nkowanu anakomana na nhwanu waka mwana waki, na jonihoju anakomana na akowanu waki.”
Kumanya chikahi
Yesu akabhapwaghi kabheti bhandu, “Pamughabhona mahundi ghapitalila kuhuma kolijibhi lyobha, panihapa mpwagha, iyula anajitonyaje, na chakaka iyula jitonya.
Chikahi pambona mpongu upogha kuhuma upambala wa kunkachi, panihapa mpwagha kubha anakupyopaje, na kukubha bhenibhela.
Mwanganya mwaka ndumi kubhele! Muweza kulingalila kunani kumahunde na pundema na kupwagha kubha iyula anajitonyaje na lyobha analibhalaje. Bho, ndepale bhole kumanya chikahi chenjenu cha sajenu?
Kujongana na adui waku
“Bho, maghambu kiki mwanganya ngachemuweza kumanya lijambu lambone la kutenda?
Ndandi paulongana na mtakila waku kukupeleka pachengu, ukangamala ujongana naku ukabya wakona mwindela. Nanga bhela mtemula anaakupelaka kwa manjolinjoli, na manjolinjoli anabhukubheka muchifungo.
Nukupwaghila, ngawipiti monihomu mbaka pawijomulya kulepa sendi ja mwisho.”
